title: Show HN: Editing 2000 photos made me build a macOS bulk photo editor
originalTitle: Show HN: Editing 2000 photos made me build a macOS bulk photo editor

Resize, Watermark & Convert

Only for Mac

Free · In‑App Purchases

Process up to 500 photos at once. Batch crop, resize, blur faces, add watermarks, and export to WebP, HEIC, AVIF & more. Fully private — 100% on-device processing. RapidPhoto is a professional batch photo editor built for macOS. Process hundreds of images in minutes with powerful tools — all running locally on your Mac for complete privacy. BATCH PROCESSING • Import up to 500 photos at once • Apply crops, adjustments, and watermarks to all images with one click • Export in 9 formats: JPEG, PNG, TIFF, HEIC, WebP, AVIF, BMP, GIF, PDF SMART CROPPING • 15 aspect ratio presets (1:1, 16:9, 4:3, 21:9, 9:16, and more) • Interactive drag-to-crop with precision handles • Per-image or batch-wide crop settings PROFESSIONAL ADJUSTMENTS • Exposure, brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness • Shadows, highlights, temperature, vibrance • Extended ±3.0 EV exposure range for professional control • One-click auto-enhance for individual parameters WATERMARKING • Full typography control: 30+ fonts, weights, and styles • 9-position grid placement with custom padding • Professional effects: shadows, outlines, background boxes • Repeating/tiled watermark patterns for security AI & MACHINE LEARNING • OCR text extraction from photos • QR code and barcode detection • Face detection and blur for privacy • Person and scene classification METADATA EDITING • Edit EXIF and IPTC fields: title, description, copyright, author • Batch-apply metadata keywords across your entire collection • Industry-standard persistence in exported files BATCH RENAMING • Custom prefix, base name, date stamps, and sequential numbering • Configurable separators and padding • Preview before export PRIVACY FIRST • Zero cloud uploads — all processing happens on your Mac • App Sandbox with minimal permissions • GDPR-compliant analytics (anonymous usage only) SUBSCRIPTION • Free tier: 10 images, common ratios, JPEG & PNG export • Premium: Unlock all 500 images, 9 formats, 15 ratios, and pro tools • Plans: Weekly ($2.99) · Monthly ($6.99) · Yearly ($39.99) Privacy Policy: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/om202/My-App-Privacy-Policies/refs/heads/main/RapidPhoto/Privacy-Policy.md Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
